title: Mega Man X3
subtitle: SNES · original X3 · X’s campaign
intro: Collect armor, hearts and Sub Tanks, follow the weapon chain, then return for the upgrades you could not reach. Start here if X3 is your first game—or jump straight to the stage you are playing.

stages.name: Blizzard Buffalo
stages.tip: Charge the Buster. After collecting the Leg Parts, climb the wall as he charges, air-dash over him and fire from behind. If you missed the capsule, use wall-jumps to avoid his rush.

items.name: Leg Parts
items.text: At the far end of the snowy outdoor section, climb the raised right-hand platform. Dash-jump from its edge to the high ledge on the right and enter the capsule.
items.extra: Adds horizontal and upward air dashes.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: After getting the legs, backtrack outside to the high ledge on the left where the stage first opened to the sky. Upward air-dash from the wall to reach the tank.
items.extra: Same visit: take the leg capsule before coming back for this.

media.alt: Blizzard Buffalo · Sub Tank — full scene

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Near the start, find the ice blocks immediately after the Ride Armor pad. Drill through them to reach the heart.

routes.name: First clear · regular upgrades + the Gold option
routes.subtitle: Recommended route
routes.description: Follow the weakness chain as X. Skip the individual pink chips from the beginning; the hidden Gold upgrade comes later.

steps.title: 01–04 · Buffalo → Seahorse → Rhino → Catfish
steps.text: Take Buffalo’s Legs, then backtrack for its tank. Collect the first-visit hearts and tanks marked below. Several capsules still need later weapons.

steps.title: 05–06 · Crawfish → Tiger
steps.text: Return to Crawfish later for its pickups. In Tiger, take the tank, Arm Parts and heart. Arms unlock charged special weapons.

steps.title: Optional pause after 06 · Vile detour
steps.text: Add this only if you want X’s saber. Destroy Vile permanently now and escape; otherwise continue with Zero alive.

steps.title: 07–08 · Beetle → Hornet, then return trips
steps.text: Get Frog, Chimera and Hornet’s heart. Return to Catfish first for Body Parts and its tank, then finish the other regular pickups.

steps.title: Doppler · Gold, refills and the ending choice
steps.text: With all 20 pickups and no pink chip installed, get Gold at full health. Use X for Mosquitus to keep Zero, or follow the saber instructions below.

extraSections:
Gold Armor & chip choices

Gold is the Hyper Chip: it combines stationary recovery, two air dashes, stronger post-hit protection and energy-powered Hyper Charge. Select Hyper Charge from the weapon menu to fire charged Buster shots using its own energy. The gold color marks these gameplay upgrades.

Never install an individual pink chip on this route. A prior chip prevents the Gold capsule from appearing. The four pink-chip cards show alternatives for a different run.

  1. Collect eight hearts, four Sub Tanks, four base armor parts and all four Ride Armor modules. Leave the four pink capsules unused.
  2. In Doppler Stage 1, defeat the early REX-2000 miniboss and refill X’s health completely. In the spiked-ball section, slide down the left wall of the first pit into the hidden passage.
  3. Enter the capsule for all four enhancement effects together. Ordinary passwords do not retain Gold Armor; collect it again after loading a password.
⤢

Zero’s saber & Vile detour

Do this before defeating all eight Mavericks. Vile’s optional teleporters disappear after that point. Keep Zero alive until Doppler Stage 2.

  1. After Neon Tiger, revisit Volt Catfish. Take the first elevator down below the normal route into Vile’s teleporter. Catfish is already defeated, so the factory’s escape elevators will work.
  2. Defeat Vile’s Ride Armor, then fight Vile himself. The final hit on his unarmored form must be Ray Splasher or Spinning Blade: he must explode rather than retreat.
  3. Escape the exploding factory before the 50-second timer runs out. Defeat the remaining Mavericks and collect the remaining pickups.
  4. In Doppler Stage 2, pass the water/Ride Armor section as X. Before the next miniboss door, switch to Zero. Defeat Mosquitus as Zero; the scripted injury transfers the saber to X. Do not defeat this miniboss as X.
  5. After the transfer, Zero is unavailable for the rest of the run and the ending differs. Charge through X’s firing sequence to use the saber. Taking the saber changes the ending.
⤢

Bit and Byte are separate decisions: destroying both changes the first fortress boss, but is not required to get the saber. Bit: finish with Frost Shield or Triad Thunder. Byte: finish with Tornado Fang or Ray Splasher. Other finishing weapons make them retreat.

Doppler fortress

Refill Sub Tanks before entering. Decide whether to take Zero’s saber before reaching the second stage.

  1. Doppler 1: Gold Armor is here. If both Bit and Byte were destroyed, fight Press Disposer; otherwise they combine as Godkarmachine O Inary. Attack exposed weak points and keep away from the crushing machinery.
  2. Doppler 2: if you destroyed Vile permanently, you can obtain the saber from Mosquitus and will face Volt Kurageil. If Vile survived, you face him again instead; this late fight cannot unlock the earlier saber route.
  3. Doppler 3: defeat the eight Maverick rematches with their listed weaknesses. Against Dr. Doppler, use Acid Burst only while his healing barrier is down.
  4. Final stage: use Spinning Blade on Sigma’s first form. Against Kaiser Sigma, hit the small exposed head with charged Buster shots, then climb quickly during the lava escape.

Useful tips

Refills and preparation

Choose your drops · Neon Tiger

Use the flying dragonfly platforms (Tomborts) in the outdoor forest to restock: defeat them with Frost Shield for health or Acid Burst for weapon energy. Move away and return to respawn them. Collect health at full life to fill Sub Tanks; select the weapon you want to refill before taking weapon energy. These guaranteed drop interactions apply to these enemies, not every enemy.

Both weapons are available before Neon Tiger on this route. Keep a dragonfly alive if you still need it as a platform to reach a pickup.

Automatic recovery · after Gold Armor

Once you have Gold Armor, stand completely still in a safe, cleared area. Its Head Chip effect gradually restores health, then Sub Tanks. Wait before entering the next boss door.

Preserve the Gold route: do not take Blast Hornet’s individual pink Head Chip just for healing. Any individual chip blocks Gold Armor. Use enemy drops until you collect Gold; see Gold Armor & chip choices.

Refill between Maverick rematches

In Doppler Stage 3’s teleporter room, shoot the central supply pod for health and weapon pickups between fights. Collect what it drops before entering the next teleporter.

routeIntro: This order keeps each boss’s weakness weapon available after the first fight. You obtain the Arm Parts at boss 6, then return for the damage-reducing Body Parts. Collect the early hearts and tanks instead of rushing straight through the bosses.
flowIntro: The numbered route uses weapons already available. A return arrow marks a pickup to collect on a later visit.
basicsHtml:
Movement details & returning to stages

Directions use actions rather than controller buttons: Jump, Dash, Fire and Special. Check your control mapping. Heart Tanks increase maximum health; Sub Tanks store excess health collected while your life bar is full. Exit from the pause menu works in cleared stages.

For an air dash, jump normally first; a dash-jump uses that movement allowance. Hold Up with Dash for the vertical air dash. After finding the Arm Parts, select a special weapon, hold Fire until it charges, then release. Charged attacks often change how the weapon works. Keep Zero alive if you want his saber later.

startHereHtml:
First time playing X3?

Collect armor, hearts and Sub Tanks

X3 hits hard before you collect upgrades. Armor, hearts and filled Sub Tanks are strongly recommended for a first playthrough. Extra health and damage protection make mistakes less costly while you learn the stages. You can finish without upgrades, but it is much harder.

Start as X. You already have a ground dash and can wall-jump by pressing Jump against a wall. Defeating a Maverick boss gives you a weapon that helps against the next boss. Some upgrades need a later weapon, so return visits are part of the route.

♥ Heart Tanks permanently increase X’s maximum health.

▣ Sub Tanks store spare health for later. Fill them by collecting health when your life bar is full; use them from the pause menu.

What the four armor parts do

Ordinary Dr. Light capsules upgrade X immediately, one part at a time.

◆ Legs Buffalo · first visit
Add a horizontal or upward air dash. Take these before Buffalo’s boss and backtrack for the Sub Tank.
◆ Arms Tiger · boss 6
Upgrade the Buster and let you charge special weapons. Several later pickups need this ability.
◆ Body Catfish · return
Reduce incoming damage and add a protective field after a hit. You need Tiger’s arms and Beetle’s Gravity Well first.
◆ Head Rhino · return
Reveal item information on the map when revisiting a cleared stage. This is a navigation aid, not a damage upgrade.
What changes in X3? Zero, Ride Armor and saving

Zero is temporary backup. You can call him once per stage visit. Switching back to X prevents another call on that visit. He cannot enter normal boss gates or collect X’s armor upgrades. If he dies, he is gone for the rest of the run.

Ride Armor is a vehicle, not X’s suit. Find Chimera in Blast Hornet’s stage before the summon pads work. Frog, Hawk and Kangaroo are additional modules; finding one early does not activate the pads.

Save your progress. In the original SNES game, record the password shown between stages. Gold Armor is not retained by an ordinary password. If your version offers a separate save system, use it too.
decisionsHtml:
Choose your extras

Two independent choices

Both secrets are optional. The recommended route leaves Gold Armor available and keeps Zero alive; you can add the saber detour separately.

Optional upgrade · Doppler 1

Gold Armor combines all four chip upgrades

The upgrades provide health and tank recovery while still, a second air dash, a stronger post-hit barrier, and Hyper Charge—charged Buster shots without waiting, using its own energy.

To obtain Gold Armor: leave all four pink-chip capsules unused. Taking any one prevents Gold Armor for the rest of this playthrough.

Collect the 20 regular pickups and reach the Gold capsule at full health. Sub Tanks do not need to be full to reveal it.

Gold requirements & capsule →
Optional weapon · Doppler 2

Give X Zero’s saber

X gains a powerful charged attack, but Zero retires after the scripted transfer and the ending changes. You can obtain Gold Armor whether you keep Zero or take his saber.

If you want the saber: keep Zero alive and permanently destroy Vile before all eight Mavericks are defeated.

On this route, pause after boss 6 for Vile. Later, use Zero for Mosquitus in Doppler Stage 2.
